name: Unidentified species
description: This species was a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. The humanoid species was distinguished by their reddish skin their elongated faces and noses, as well as large head of black hair. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present on the Glavis Ringworld space station when the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin arrived with the severed head of the Klatooinian Kaba Baiz.
